answer: A hollow identity is cheap to fake, so entry should require three established sponsors to vouch for a newcomer, each locking 25 POA for 30 days; if the newcomer runs duplicate accounts, all three deposits are slashed and the sponsors lose vouching rights for a year. The newcomer starts at the foot of the summit, earning full weight only after 90 days of honest work, and the voyage from newcomer to trusted member is recorded on a graph, so a cluster that only vouches for itself is visible and can be quarantined by a random jury. One fake then costs 75 POA plus three compromised sponsors.
